CFML Language Reference: Functions

URLEncodedFormat

Returns a URL-encoded copy of a string: every character other than a letter or a digit is replaced by a percent sign and its two-digit hexadecimal code. Spaces become %20.

Category

String functions

Syntax

URLEncodedFormat(string)

Parameters

string
The string to encode.

Returns

The encoded string.

Usage

Always encode values you put into the query string of a link or a CFLOCATION URL. An unencoded &, # or space in a value will cut the parameter short. KoldFusion decodes URL variables automatically when the next page receives them. URLDecode reverses the encoding by hand.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFPARAM NAME="URL.Search" DEFAULT="Tom & Jerry's 100% fun">
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Received: #URL.Search#</P>
<P>Encoded: <TT>#URLEncodedFormat(URL.Search)#</TT></P>
<P><A HREF="urlencodedformat.cfm?Search=#URLEncodedFormat("Fish & Chips ##1")#">Try another value</A></P>
</CFOUTPUT>
